body.text: How do you loop Çavuşin, Paşabağ and Devrent in 3 hours without bus crowds?

Start at Çavuşin Old Village at 08:00, drive five minutes to Paşabağ by 08:50, and reach Devrent Valley by 10:15. Most organized Cappadocia Red Tours stop at Göreme Open Air Museum first and spill into Paşabağ between 10:00 and 12:30, so this compact clockwise loop stays consistently ahead of coach groups.

The entire triangle covers barely 12 km of paved road between Göreme, Avanos, and Ürgüp inside the [UNESCO Göreme and Cappadocia](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/357/) region. If you prefer an afternoon loop instead of an early start, run the exact reverse order beginning at Devrent around 15:30 and finishing at Çavuşin's ridge as the coaches head back to hotels.

body.text: What is the 5th-century Church of St. John the Baptist in Çavuşin?

Perched near the top of Çavuşin's honeycombed cliff face 2.5 km north of Göreme, the 5th-century Church of St. John the Baptist is one of Cappadocia's oldest and largest rock-cut basilicas. Its broad barrel-vaulted nave, carved columns, and weathered early Christian paintings sit above the abandoned cave homes evacuated after 1950s rockfalls.

Do not confuse this hilltop basilica with the separate roadside Çavuşin Church (the 10th-century Nicephorus Phocas Church, dated to 964–965 CE), which Türkiye's Ministry of Culture and Tourism lists as closed for restoration on [muze.gov.tr](https://muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?SectionId=CAV01&DistId=MRK). The hilltop Old Village path to St. John the Baptist remains open to walk and rewards climbers with wide views across Red and Rose Valleys.
Does MuseumPass cover Paşabağ and Zelve?

Yes. Both [MuseumPass Cappadocia](https://muze.gov.tr/urun-detay?CatalogNo=WEB-MSP01-19-009) (€65 for three days) and [MuseumPass Türkiye](https://muze.gov.tr/urun-detay?CatalogNo=WEB-MSP01-27-009) (€165 for fifteen days) cover entry to the combined Zelve–Paşabağlar Archaeological Site. Without a pass, the 2026 foreign-visitor e-ticket costs €12 and grants entry to both Paşabağ and Zelve Open Air Museum, located 1 km apart.

You can verify official hours and e-ticket pricing directly on the [Zelve–Paşabağlar page](https://muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?DistId=ZPO&SectionId=ZPO01) and the Ministry's [Zelve–Paşabağlar e-ticket portal](https://muze.gov.tr/urun-ekle?catalogNo=WEB-ZPO01-87-009). At Paşabağ, look closely at the three-headed fairy chimney that housed St. Simeon's hermit cell; if you have an extra 45 minutes, use the same €12 ticket to walk Zelve's three monastic valleys, inhabited until 1952.
What time of day gives the best rock-formation light?

Two narrow windows flatter Cappadocia's pale tuff and darker basalt caps: the first ninety minutes after sunrise (roughly 07:30–09:00 in shoulder seasons) and the final ninety minutes before sunset. Midday sun flattens the volcanic textures and washes out Devrent's soft pink ridges, whereas low-angle light carves crisp shadows beneath Paşabağ's mushroom caps.
Keep these practical points in mind before setting out:

items: Buy your €12 Zelve–Paşabağlar e-ticket or MuseumPass ahead of time to skip the booth queue.
Wear grippy soles for the short uphill scramble to Çavuşin's hilltop basilica.
Carry water and sun protection; neither Paşabağ nor Devrent offers much shade.
Park only in marked roadside bays at Devrent rather than on the highway shoulder.

faq.q: Can you walk between Çavuşin and Paşabağ?
faq.a: Yes. A mostly level 2 km footpath and quiet back road links Çavuşin Old Village to Paşabağ in about 25 to 30 minutes, making an easy morning walk if you have a driver pick you up at Devrent.

faq.q: Is Devrent Imagination Valley free to enter in 2026?
faq.a: Yes. Devrent is an open roadside valley with no ticket gate, no opening hours restriction, and free roadside parking.

faq.q: Does the €12 Paşabağ ticket include Zelve Open Air Museum?
faq.a: Yes. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism issues one combined ticket (Zelve - Paşabağlar Örenyeri) covering both sites, which sit 1 km apart.

faq.q: Is the roadside Nicephorus Phocas Church in Çavuşin open?
faq.a: According to muze.gov.tr, the roadside Çavuşin Church (Nicephorus Phocas Church) is closed for restoration, though the 5th-century Church of St. John the Baptist atop Old Çavuşin remains accessible.

faq.q: How long should you budget if you add Zelve Open Air Museum to the loop?
faq.a: Add 60 to 75 minutes to walk Zelve's three valleys, turning the 3-hour loop into a comfortable 4-hour half-day outing.

faq.q: Can you visit Çavuşin, Paşabağ, and Devrent without a guided tour?
faq.a: Yes. All three stops have clear paths and signage, and a rental car or private half-day driver gives you full control over arrival times to beat the 10:00 bus rush.
